notes: Product 2-Up Label System. General product labels now print two side-by-side on one US Letter landscape sheet, matching the carpet-roll workflow. Left and Right products are selected independently, so a sheet can contain two different products or the same product twice. Product/collection/colour hierarchy is enlarged and rebalanced, QR codes are lifted slightly for cleaner bottom spacing, and canonical warehouse.runlu.ca deep links are retained. Existing Cloud Sync, inventory data, carpet workflows, Private Administrator access and Multi-AI/GPT Gateway are unchanged.
